s01.translation: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit.

s02.translation: As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

w002.function: Glory to whom — to the Father; the first of three datives of the Trinity.

w009.function: Continuing state in the past; the understood subject is the glory.

w017.function: With the accusative — extent through time: “unto the ages”. Compare “in” (w010) with the ablative — a point in time.

w019.function: Genitive with “sǽcula” (w018): ages of ages — like “Holy of Holies”.
